All requested window expression helpers, window specification APIs, frame utilities, and chainable `.window()` query builder methods have been implemented, tested, and committed to a new branch from `main`.

### Summary of Changes

1. **Window Expression Helpers & Utilities** ([`window.ts`](file:///app/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts)):
   - **Ranking helpers**: [`rowNumber()`](file:///app/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts#L173), [`rank()`](file:///app/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts#L182), [`denseRank()`](file:///app/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts#L191), [`ntile(n)`](file:///app/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts#L201), [`percentRank()`](file:///app/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts#L220), [`cumeDist()`](file:///app/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts#L229).
   - **Offset helpers**: [`lag(val, offset?, default?)`](file:///app/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts#L241), [`lead(val, offset?, default?)`](file:///app/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts#L273), [`firstValue(val)`](file:///app/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts#L305), [`lastValue(val)`](file:///app/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts#L316), [`nthValue(val, n)`](file:///app/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts#L327).
   - **Aggregates**: [`windowSum(val)`](file:///app/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts#L349), [`windowAvg(val)`](file:///app/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts#L358), [`windowMin(val)`](file:///app/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts#L367), [`windowMax(val)`](file:///app/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts#L376), [`windowCount(val?)`](file:///app/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts#L385).
   - **Frame constructors & boundaries**: [`rows({ from, to })`](file:///app/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts#L143), [`range({ from, to })`](file:///app/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts#L154), [`unboundedPreceding`](file:///app/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts#L93), [`currentRow`](file:///app/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts#L111), [`unboundedFollowing`](file:///app/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts#L129), [`preceding(n)`](file:///app/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts#L98), [`following(n)`](file:///app/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts#L116).
   - **Validation & constraints**:
     - Positional integer arguments (`offset`, `n`, `nth`, frame boundaries) emit as raw SQL literals (`sql.raw(String(n))`) to avoid bound query parameters (even when `0`).
     - `ntile` and `nthValue` validate that arguments are positive integers (throws error with function name and value).
     - `preceding` and `following` validate that numeric arguments are non-negative integers (throws error with helper name).
     - `rows` and `range` validate ordering so that `from` is not ordered after `to` (throws error referencing `"from"`).
     - `windowCount()` without an argument emits `count(*)`.
     - Value-access functions type returns as nullable; `lag` and `lead` strip null when a default value is supplied.
     - Empty `.over()` emits `over ()`.
     - Named window references emit `over "name"` without parentheses.

2. **Dialect Query Builders & Compilers**:
   - Added chainable `.window(name, spec)` method and `windows` query config to PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, SingleStore, and Gel select builders.
   - Name validation on `.window()` checks against empty strings (containing `"non-empty"`) and whitespace-only strings (containing `"whitespace"`).
   - Compiles named window definitions into a `WINDOW <name> AS (<spec>)` clause placed immediately before `ORDER BY`.

3. **Package Exports**:
   - Exported all helpers, constants, types, and frame utilities from [`drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts`](file:///app/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts) up to the top-level package `drizzle-orm`.

4. **Testing & Verification**:
   - Added comprehensive test suite in [`drizzle-orm/tests/window.test.ts`](file:///app/drizzle-orm/tests/window.test.ts) covering unit tests, compilation across dialects, validation constraints, and type tests.
   - Ran `pnpm test`, `pnpm test:types`, and `pnpm build`, passing all workspace checks cleanly.
   - Committed all changes to branch `feat/window-functions`.
